description.en: Read .pptx decks in the right sidebar (dsh-better-sidebar consumer): a slide list in deck order, text with bullet levels, speaker notes and inline pictures, guarded by a circuit breaker. Reading view, not a slide reproduction.
description.zh: 在右侧栏阅读 .pptx 演示文稿（dsh-better-sidebar 消费者）：按放映顺序的幻灯片清单、带层级的项目符号文本、演讲备注与内联图片，带熔断保护。是阅读视图，不是版式还原。
